title: Onye Ndú A Họpụtara n'Otu Mba
intro: N'oge nnukwu ihe ịma aka na nkụda mmụọ maka ndị mmadụ, e mere nhọpụta Chineke. Onye a, nke ọtụtụ mmadụ leghaara anya na mbụ, ka Allah họpụtara ka o duru mba megide onye iro dị egwu. Akụkọ ha bụ ihe akaebe nke ike nke okwukwe na amamihe dị n'ime iwu Chineke, na-egosi na a naghị ahụ ezi onye ndu mgbe niile n'ebe a tụrụ anya ya.
clues: Allah họpụtara m ka m bụrụ onye ndu nye ndị m mgbe ha chọrọ onye ọchịchị ga-alụ ọgụ maka ebumnuche Ya.
Ndị m na mbụ jụrụ ajụjụ banyere nhọpụta m, na-eche na ndị ọzọ kwesịrị ekwesị karịa n'ihi akụnụba ma ọ bụ agbụrụ ha.
Ihe ịrịba ama nke ịbụ onye ndu m ziri ezi bụ nlọghachi nke igbe nsọ, nke nwere ihe ncheta sitere n'aka ndị amụma gara aga, nke wetara udo.
Eduru m ndị agha m gaa n'osimiri, ebe m nwalechara nrubeisi ha site n'ịmachibido ha ịṅụ ihe karịrị otu iko mmiri.
N'agbanyeghị na anyị nwere obere ọnụọgụgụ ndị nọgidere na-eguzosi ike mgbe ule ahụ gasịrị, anyị zutere otu dike dị ike na ndị agha ha.
N'okpuru nduzi m, otu nwa okorobịa si n'òtù ndị agha m, onye na-abụghị onye agha a ma ama, ji obi ike lụọ ọgụ ma merie dike iro ahụ dị egwu.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ihe ịma aka nke ndị dibịa afa
Nhọpụta dịka onye ndu megide nnukwu mmadụ
Idei mmiri nke rikpuru ala ahụ
trial.answer: Nhọpụta dịka onye ndu megide nnukwu mmadụ

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E guzobere alaeze nwere akụnụba na ike dị ukwuu.
Oké idei mmiri kpuchiri ndị mmadụ ahụ.
E meriri onye mmeri nke onye iro ahụ, Allah wee nye ya mmeri.
Oké ọkọchị tara ala ahụ ahụhụ ruo ọtụtụ afọ.
Nnukwu anụ e kere eke loro onye ndu ahụ.
outcome.answer: E meriri onye mmeri nke onye iro ahụ, Allah wee nye ya mmeri.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
